_about: Public-domain James Janeway (1636?-1674), Nonconformist minister of Rotherhithe, for the Word Hoard: A Token for Children (1811 complete edition), Invisibles, Realities (the life of his brother John Janeway, 1814), The Saints' Encouragement to Diligence (1833), A Token for Mariners (1708) and A Token for Youth (1720). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 94 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

janeway-invisibles-realities: Invisibles, realities, demonstrated in the holy life and triumphant death of Mr. John Janeway, fellow of King's College in Cambridge (Pittsfield [Mass.] Printed by Phinehas Allen, 1814)
janeway-saints-encouragement: The saints' encouragement to diligence in Christ's service : with motives and means to Christian activity ; to which is added as an example to prove the point handled, the death-bed experiences of Mrs. B (London : Religious Tract Society, 1833)

_excluded.janeway-early: the 1667-1680 first printings (Early English Books), left for the EEBO first-editions work
_excluded.janeway-extracts: extracts and abridgements by John Wesley and James Wheatley
